items.title: 8.12 Concentration ki tabdeeli ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.12, printed page 180.

blocks.text: Agar equilibrium par system mein kisi reactant ya product ka kuch hissa shamil ya hataya jaye to equilibrium ki position chher di jati hai. Chaar imkanat hain. Bismuth chloride ke hydrolysis par ghaur karein, BiCl3 + H2O se BiOCl + 2HCl, jis mein BiCl3 pani se react kar ke safed na-halne wala compound BiOCl deta hai; expression Kc = [HCl]^2 / [BiCl3] hai (solid BiOCl aur solvent pani Kc mein nahi aate). Jab BiCl3 solution mein pani dala jaye to woh safed precipitate se dhundla ho jata hai; equilibrium par kuch BiOCl aur HCl ban chuke hain aur kuch BiCl3 baqi hai.

items: BiCl3 ya pani shamil karna equilibrium chherta hai; use dobara qaim karne ke liye zyada BiOCl aur HCl bante hain, reaction aage dhakeli jati hai, Kc mustaqil rehta hai magar position badalti hai.
HCl shamil karna: zyada BiCl3 banta hai aur reaction ulti simt chalti hai; Kc mustaqil, position badli.
Kuch BiCl3 hatana: reaction bharpai ke liye ulti simt chalti hai; Kc mustaqil ke saath nayi position.
HCl hatana: reaction bharpai ke liye aage chalti hai; nayi position, Kc mustaqil.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Kc = [BiOCl][HCl]^2 / ([BiCl3][H2O]) likha hai aur kaha hai ke BiOCl shamil karne ya hatane se equilibrium shift hota hai. BiOCl safed na-halne wala solid hai aur pani solvent hai; in dono ki concentration mustaqil rehti hai, is liye yeh Kc mein nahi likhe jate (kitab khud Ksp wale hisse mein solid ko Kc ke saath mila deti hai). Sahi expression Kc = [HCl]^2 / [BiCl3] hai, aur thora sa solid BiOCl shamil karne ya hatane se equilibrium nahi hilta; sirf HCl ya BiCl3 ki tabdeeli position badalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Equilibrium par 2H2(g) + O2(g) se 2H2O(g) ke liye, agar zyada pani ke bukharat shamil kiye jayein to H2 aur O2 ki concentrations ko kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Product shamil karna equilibrium chherta hai, jo shamil pani ka kuch hissa kharch karne ke liye baen shift hota hai. Is amal mein H2 aur O2 bante hain, to un ki concentrations barhti hain, jabke Kc be-tabdeel.

items: Reactant shamil ya product hatao: aage shift; product shamil ya reactant hatao: peechhe shift (BiCl3 hydrolysis, safed BiOCl ka banna ya halna); position badalti hai, Kc nahi.
